newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Segue rating cut after EPS forecast.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Segue rating cut after EPS forecast.

text.p: Segue Software Inc was downgraded by stockbroker Alex. Brown to market perform from buy on Tuesday morning.
-- The company said its second quarter results will not meet Wall Street forecasts after the market close on Monday.
-- The stock fell 39 percent, losing 5-1/8 to eight in early trading, making it the top losing stock on the Nasdaq on a percent basis.
-- The Newtown Centre, Mass. company makes software used for automated testing and quality management of client/server software applications.
-- It said second-quarter revenues should run about $5.4 million compared with $3.5 million last year, up 52 percent.

-- It said the "shortfall in revenues" came from several factors. Segue cited problems with its original equipment manufacturer (OEM) product QA Performer, including "issues attached to ease-of-use and extended evaluation cycle issues."

-- It said the late-in-the-quarter introduction of its new SilkTest product meant delays in QA Partner orders as customers evaluated SilkTest. It also blamed "sales forecasting issues and direct sales capability issues" for the revenue shortfall.
-- Said profits should be about a penny a share compared with a loss of nil last year, with a net profit of $50,000 compared with a loss of about $29,000.
